source.member: System.Enum.GetNames(Type), GetValues(Type), GetName(Type, object) and Enum.ToString() over ACE.Entity's enums
source.notes: One case per enum (in.name, in.aliased). out.names: GetNames order (= GetValues order); out.keys: each value as ToUInt64 sees it; out.get_name / out.to_string: for each distinct key, in GetValues order, Enum.GetName and ToString().
